notes: P64 completion evidence binds delivered scope/final invoice/performance confirmation to the same record and site as the final HET and energy calculation. Window replacement in realized scope plus explicit post-state opening U in the final calculation yields component-specific performance evidence.

Public KTI product registry publishes approved construction products and performance declarations. It becomes project evidence only when the exact installed product/document is linked through project invoice/scope evidence; catalogue presence alone is insufficient.
Eligibility or legal U requirement alone is not realized component performance.
Final certificate/calculation can provide post-state U values but cannot by itself prove which openings were replaced in the project.

A cohort must enumerate completed window projects with project/site identity, realized window scope and at least one admitted performance path. Public programme totals do not supply this technical cohort.
